notes: Pronunciation overrides applied by the narration generator (tools/tts) before synthesis, per locale. Episodes may add episodes/<ep>/pronunciation.json with the same shape (episode entries win). Each entry matches an exact, case-sensitive phrase and replaces how it is spoken with ONE of: 'say' (respelling, phonemized in the locale's language), 'lang' (phonemize this span with another espeak language, e.g. keep English product names English inside Spanish) or 'phonemes' (literal Kokoro/IPA phonemes). Verify every entry by ear.

es.note: Product name keeps its English pronunciation inside Spanish narration. Verify by ear.
